4.2 million passengers, one dot per 5,000

The wings and tailplane are the thinnest parts of any shape in the collection, so this is the layout that needs the most dots before it reads. Below roughly 160 the wings thin to a single dot each and the plane becomes a cross.

1 dot = 5,000 passengers
